name: Outlook
description: Start sessions from Outlook mail, and search, read and draft replies from any session. Never sends.

connections.why: Reads your mail for the From an Outlook mail board and the outlook_* tools.
Saves reply drafts in Drafts; never sends.

launch.label: From an Outlook mail…
launch.description: Unread, Inbox and Flagged mail as a board, one card per conversation. Starts a session with the whole conversation and its attachments.
launch.searchPlaceholder: Search mail (KQL): from:ada subject:invoice received>=2026-10-01 hasattachments:true

settings.label: Check mail every (minutes)
settings.description: How often the board, the unread count and replies in started conversations are refreshed.

settings.label: Microsoft account
settings.description: Which connected Microsoft account to read, by its address or connection id. Empty: the first one. "Switch account…" on the board overrides it.

settings.label: Board columns
settings.description: Columns separated by |, each Name = unread, inbox, flagged or a KQL search, e.g. Unread = unread | Invoices = subject:invoice hasattachments:true.
settings.default: Unread = unread | Inbox = inbox | Flagged = flagged
